about: Proposed region definition for a detailed map of Paraguay, as one region for the whole country, with the 17 departments and Asunción listed as an alternative. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-PY.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.why: A bare PY collides with no US code in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py).
codes.alternative: ISO 3166-2:PY: PY-ASU for Asunción, PY-1 to PY-16 and PY-19 for the departments.
codes.warning: OCHA COD-AB p-codes differ from ISO for two departments: PY16 is Boquerón (ISO PY-19) and PY17 is Alto Paraguay (ISO PY-16). Join by name, not by number.
codes.verified: The ISO 3166-2 codes were not checked against the ISO site (search only).

regions.name: Paraguay

box_source.dataset: OCHA COD-AB Paraguay (pry_admin0.geojson / pry_admin1.geojson), source DGEEC / INE, valid_on 2026-07-29
box_source.rule: Extent of every vertex, minus/plus 0.15 degrees (the margin of map_sets.state in derived/packs/pack-spec.json), rounded outward to 0.01 degrees.

regions.clip: Geofabrik's extract is already cut a few kilometres outside the border, so a first build holds almost nothing of the neighbours and cuts the twin cities (Posadas, Foz do Iguaçu, Ponta Porã, Clorinda). Suggested: the border as the edge of a first build, and later a band (for example 20 km) from the Argentina and Brazil extracts. Undecided.
regions.area_note: area_km2 is the area_sqkm attribute of COD-AB level 0; the official figure is 406,752 km2 (general knowledge).
regions.neighbours_in_box: From a sample of points, not measured. Argentina: all of Formosa, most of Chaco province, northern Corrientes, most of Misiones province, a corner of Santiago del Estero, a sliver of Salta. Brazil: much of Mato Grosso do Sul, the western edge of Paraná, a corner of Rio Grande do Sul. Bolivia: parts of the south-east.

alternative_regions.about: If finer regions are wanted. Central's box contains the whole of Asunción's, so a PY-11 map cut by its box holds Asunción too. A map of the metropolitan area (which also takes in the Villa Hayes side of Presidente Hayes) would be a separate grouping with its own id, not a PY-11 that means more than Central.

box_source.dataset: OCHA COD-AB Paraguay (pry_admin0.geojson / pry_admin1.geojson), source DGEEC / INE, valid_on 2026-07-29
box_source.rule: Extent of every vertex, minus/plus 0.15 degrees (the margin of map_sets.state in derived/packs/pack-spec.json), rounded outward to 0.01 degrees.

alternative_regions.middle_option: Two regions: eastern Paraguay (14 departments and Asunción) and the Chaco (PY-15, PY-16, PY-19). This split would also cut Greater Asunción, whose Chaco side lies in Presidente Hayes.

base_map_and_poi.dataset: OSM extract paraguay-latest.osm.pbf (147 MB); shp.zip 305 MB, gpkg.zip 312 MB

places.dataset: OCHA COD-AB levels 1 to 4 plus adminpoints and admincapitals; OSM named places
places.verified: HDX record opened on 2026-11-17; admin0 and admin1 downloads confirmed

places_and_streets_official.dataset: INE Cartografía Digital 2012: departments, districts, barrios and localities, cities, blocks (manzanas), roads, main roads, hydrography, indigenous communities; Shape, KML, GeoJSON
places_and_streets_official.caveat: Predates the 2022 census; no downloadable 2022 cartography found (search only).

water.dataset: OSM waterways and water areas; INE 2012 hydrography to fill gaps
water.gap: No open dam inventory and no dataset of Chaco cisterns (aljibes) or earth reservoirs (tajamares) found.

crops.dataset: MapBiomas Paraguay Collection 2, annual land cover and land use 1985-2023, 30 m (land cover classes, not crop types); ESA WorldCover 2021 as fallback
crops.verified: terms page opened 2026-11-17; collection details search only

buildings.dataset: Google Open Buildings v3; Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints to fill gaps
buildings.verified: Google's page opened 2026-11-17 (PRY in the v3 list); coverage not measured
buildings.notes: Google offers the data under CC BY 4.0 or ODbL 1.0, at the user's choice. Microsoft: see docs/regions-proposed.json.

addresses.gap: Overture's address theme (release 2026-10-21.0) lists 41 countries and Paraguay is not among them. OSM has 44,614 objects with addr:housenumber.

osm_counts.about: Counted with pyosmium over paraguay-latest.osm.pbf (data up to 2026-11-16T21:22:36Z); nodes, ways and relations.
osm_counts.caveat: amenity=shelter marks small roofs, not emergency shelters.

notes.man_made=storage_tank: contents not checked; some will not hold water
notes.amenity=hospital: Rows, not sites: in a test map of Central and Asunción, 163 hospital rows were about 113 sites (rows within 150 m grouped).

help_point_gaps.health: No downloadable Ministry of Health (MSPBS) facility list with coordinates found; reports say it exists and was shared on formal request (search only).
help_point_gaps.fire_stations: About 140 volunteer fire stations (CBVP) per news reports (search only); no published location list. OSM has 123.
help_point_gaps.shelters: SEN flood shelters are opened as needed; no dataset found (search only).
help_point_gaps.chaco_water: No dataset of aljibes or tajamares found.

addressing.order: Street, then door number, then city: "José Martí 1953, Luque" (search only).
addressing.corners: Often given by corner: "c/" (casi) or "esq." (esquina); many homes are "s/n" (no number). General knowledge.
addressing.postcode: Six digits: department, district, barrio (search only). Older four-digit codes are still seen (general knowledge). engine/address_search.py reads only \d{5}; tools/build_addresses.py keeps left(postcode, 5).
addressing.accents: normalize() in engine/address_search.py and norm() in tools/build_addresses.py keep only a-z, 0-9 and spaces, so every other letter becomes a space: "Avda. Mcal. López 1234 c/ Ñeembucú" becomes "avda mcal l pez 1234 c eembuc" (tested 2026-11-17). Folding is needed on both sides; see related.pr_79.
addressing.place_finder: FTS5 unicode61 folds diacritics: "itapesyi" finds "Itapesỹi" (a real name:gn in the extract). No place name with g̃ was found in the extract; a made-up spelling with it matched plain g (tested 2026-11-17).
addressing.verified: Correo Paraguayo pages not checked; needs a native reader.
addressing.postcode_lookup: Correo Paraguayo (DINACOPA) has an online look-up (search only; not opened).

undecided: The box rule: the border as the edge of a first build, and a later band for twin cities
One region, two, or eighteen (plus a separate metropolitan grouping)
Address search (six-digit postcodes, number after street, corners, accent folding)
Help points with no open source
Language: Spanish or Guaraní names; font coverage for Guaraní letters
